title: Colombia Lion:
title_q: “A Smile, a Hug Is More Than Enough”
title_short: Colombia Lion · A Smile, a Hug
headline: An optometrist Lion from Colombia brings her profession to her club's vision work, and says sometimes a smile and a hug are more than enough.
story: She speaks Spanish. Atdhe asks why she is a Lion: because we serve with our hearts. She is an optometrist, and vision is one of the Lions programs, so serving as a vision professional matters to her. Her club in Colombia helps people with low resources with vision campaigns and lenses.

The tie-back is her heart: next to you there can be a person who is not well, and sometimes a smile, a hug is more than enough. Warm and gentle. There is no friendship story in this interview, so Atdhe decides if it ships.
